name: Claws of Hell refreshes Unleash Apocalypse through Flames of Xoroth and Hellrider (#12134)
contract: Claws of Hell 805706 reads 'When you spend at least 4 Demonfire stacks you now refresh the duration of your Unleash Apocalypse on the target.' Unleash Apocalypse 560817 lasts 8 s (DurationIndex 31). Flames of Xoroth (802411 at level 20) hits a cone (TARGET_UNIT_CONE_ENEMY_24) and Hellrider 803889 is a self buff, so neither cast keeps an explicit unit target; for them the target is the knight's current selection. The dummy carries the knight's Unleash Apocalypse and stays selected. A Flames of Xoroth that spends 3 Demonfire leaves the shortened aura alone; one that spends 4 refreshes it to its full 8 s, and so does a 4-stack Hellrider. Spell hit rating 10000 keeps a miss from refunding the Demonfire.

steps.label: Let spawn AI and level scaling settle
Force the Claws of Hell passive aura
The knight's Unleash Apocalypse on the dummy
SETUP: Unleash Apocalypse starts at 8 s
Let the aura run down
Three Demonfire stacks
Flames of Xoroth spending 3 Demonfire
SETUP: Flames of Xoroth hit the dummy
CONTRACT: 3 Demonfire does not refresh Unleash Apocalypse
Clear the global cooldown
Four Demonfire stacks
Flames of Xoroth spending 4 Demonfire
SETUP: the second Flames of Xoroth hit the dummy
CONTRACT: Flames of Xoroth with 4 Demonfire refreshes Unleash Apocalypse
Let the aura run down again
SETUP: Unleash Apocalypse is short again
Four Demonfire stacks
Hellrider spending 4 Demonfire
SETUP: Hellrider is active
CONTRACT: Hellrider with 4 Demonfire refreshes Unleash Apocalypse on the selected target
